base_layout.cycle_information: 24 h progress plus signed battery/H2/CO2/CH4 margins to one non-ratcheting opening reference
base_layout.constraint_output: per-cycle resource return feasibility and cost vector

interface_contract.market_fields: Effective accepted-solar dispatch charge; zero for dedicated PV without export. Underlying synthetic market remains private audit data.

timing.time_semantics: observe boundary t; hold one decision over [t,t+decision_interval); settle a deadline after production in its final physical interval; expose only the causal forecast issued at t with half-open lead windows
timing.flow_sampling_semantics: timestamp and inventories are current after the preceding decision interval; solar availability/potential/output factor and equipment health/online state are the final one-minute dispatch sample in that interval; power, load, and production are time-weighted means over the whole interval (reset uses the initial boundary sample because no interval exists); electrolyser commitment mode, timers, prior accepted power, and ramp headroom are current boundary state
timing.guard_semantics: controllers decide from causal boundary telemetry; before every physical step the actuator guard applies absolute kW caps against the simulator-owned solar bus that same step will dispatch
timing.episode_end_semantics: the configured contract horizon is an intrinsic finite-horizon termination (terminated=true, truncated=false); terminal inventory is valued once and value functions must not bootstrap beyond the final observation

common_setpoint_authority.support_semantics: dispatcher-owned contemporaneous electrolyser-target shortfall, bounded by reserve-aware safety availability

assumptions.calibration_status: literature-anchored benchmark assumptions; not a vendor quote, site tariff, or bankable financial model

tariff.negative_price_semantics: renewable energy may be curtailed, so its opportunity price is floored at zero in the objective

economic_objective.realized_price_source: Effective electricity model price; dedicated PV has no export or purchase charge
economic_objective.negative_price_semantics: accepted renewable opportunity cost remains floored at zero

base_checkpoint_contract.cycle_constraint_semantics: battery, H2, CO2, and CH4 settle separately against one non-ratcheting episode-opening reference at each 24 h boundary; constraint cost is reported separately and is not monetized
base_checkpoint_contract.disturbance_visibility: only currently observable plant effects; no future schedule, seed, or selected market regime

electricity_model.calibration: Inferred off-grid architecture; fixed costs unknown, excluded from modeled operating contribution, not asserted zero.

policy_identity.base_observation: actual returned float32[135]; no extra encoding
policy_identity.normalization: cached target / installed rating, clipped to [0,1]
policy_identity.mapping: E at/below stable floor is preserved; otherwise floor+(E-floor)*(1+0.1*r). Other targets multiply by (1+0.1*r); current authority caps apply. Zero residual returns the exact original command.

prior.information_set: Current public plant, delivery and cycle observation; static plant and commitment profile; no future truth or scenario identity.
prior.objective: Deliver current daily obligations and restore opening stocks before nightfall; economic prices unused.

policy_identity.authority: Bounded residual only; no feasibility or safety guarantee and no policy substitution.

base_layout.cycle_information: 24 h progress plus signed battery/H2/CO2/CH4 margins to one non-ratcheting opening reference
base_layout.constraint_output: per-cycle resource return feasibility and cost vector

interface_contract.market_fields: Effective accepted-solar dispatch charge; zero for dedicated PV without export. Underlying synthetic market remains private audit data.

timing.time_semantics: observe boundary t; hold one decision over [t,t+decision_interval); settle a deadline after production in its final physical interval; expose only the causal forecast issued at t with half-open lead windows
timing.flow_sampling_semantics: timestamp and inventories are current after the preceding decision interval; solar availability/potential/output factor and equipment health/online state are the final one-minute dispatch sample in that interval; power, load, and production are time-weighted means over the whole interval (reset uses the initial boundary sample because no interval exists); electrolyser commitment mode, timers, prior accepted power, and ramp headroom are current boundary state
timing.guard_semantics: controllers decide from causal boundary telemetry; before every physical step the actuator guard applies absolute kW caps against the simulator-owned solar bus that same step will dispatch
timing.episode_end_semantics: the configured contract horizon is an intrinsic finite-horizon termination (terminated=true, truncated=false); terminal inventory is valued once and value functions must not bootstrap beyond the final observation

common_setpoint_authority.support_semantics: dispatcher-owned contemporaneous electrolyser-target shortfall, bounded by reserve-aware safety availability

assumptions.calibration_status: literature-anchored benchmark assumptions; not a vendor quote, site tariff, or bankable financial model

tariff.negative_price_semantics: renewable energy may be curtailed, so its opportunity price is floored at zero in the objective

economic_objective.realized_price_source: Effective electricity model price; dedicated PV has no export or purchase charge
economic_objective.negative_price_semantics: accepted renewable opportunity cost remains floored at zero

base_checkpoint_contract.cycle_constraint_semantics: battery, H2, CO2, and CH4 settle separately against one non-ratcheting episode-opening reference at each 24 h boundary; constraint cost is reported separately and is not monetized
base_checkpoint_contract.disturbance_visibility: only currently observable plant effects; no future schedule, seed, or selected market regime

electricity_model.calibration: Inferred off-grid architecture; fixed costs unknown, excluded from modeled operating contribution, not asserted zero.

policy_identity.base_observation: actual returned float32[135]; no extra encoding
policy_identity.normalization: cached target / installed rating, clipped to [0,1]
policy_identity.mapping: E at/below stable floor is preserved; otherwise floor+(E-floor)*(1+0.1*r). Other targets multiply by (1+0.1*r); current authority caps apply. Zero residual returns the exact original command.

prior.information_set: Current public plant, delivery and cycle observation; static plant and commitment profile; no future truth or scenario identity.
prior.objective: Deliver current daily obligations and restore opening stocks before nightfall; economic prices unused.

policy_identity.authority: Bounded residual only; no feasibility or safety guarantee and no policy substitution.

electricity_model.calibration: Inferred off-grid architecture; fixed costs unknown, excluded from modeled operating contribution, not asserted zero.
Inferred off-grid architecture; fixed costs unknown, excluded from modeled operating contribution, not asserted zero.

runs.change: New25kg/h off-grid task; original physical draw and all mandatory service, daily inventory and safety requirements retained.

base_layout.cycle_information: 24 h progress plus signed battery/H2/CO2/CH4 margins to one non-ratcheting opening reference
base_layout.constraint_output: per-cycle resource return feasibility and cost vector

interface_contract.market_fields: Effective accepted-solar dispatch charge; zero for dedicated PV without export. Underlying synthetic market remains private audit data.

timing.time_semantics: observe boundary t; hold one decision over [t,t+decision_interval); settle a deadline after production in its final physical interval; expose only the causal forecast issued at t with half-open lead windows
timing.flow_sampling_semantics: timestamp and inventories are current after the preceding decision interval; solar availability/potential/output factor and equipment health/online state are the final one-minute dispatch sample in that interval; power, load, and production are time-weighted means over the whole interval (reset uses the initial boundary sample because no interval exists); electrolyser commitment mode, timers, prior accepted power, and ramp headroom are current boundary state
timing.guard_semantics: controllers decide from causal boundary telemetry; before every physical step the actuator guard applies absolute kW caps against the simulator-owned solar bus that same step will dispatch
timing.episode_end_semantics: the configured contract horizon is an intrinsic finite-horizon termination (terminated=true, truncated=false); terminal inventory is valued once and value functions must not bootstrap beyond the final observation

common_setpoint_authority.support_semantics: dispatcher-owned contemporaneous electrolyser-target shortfall, bounded by reserve-aware safety availability

assumptions.calibration_status: literature-anchored benchmark assumptions; not a vendor quote, site tariff, or bankable financial model

tariff.negative_price_semantics: renewable energy may be curtailed, so its opportunity price is floored at zero in the objective

economic_objective.realized_price_source: Effective electricity model price; dedicated PV has no export or purchase charge
economic_objective.negative_price_semantics: accepted renewable opportunity cost remains floored at zero

base_checkpoint_contract.cycle_constraint_semantics: battery, H2, CO2, and CH4 settle separately against one non-ratcheting episode-opening reference at each 24 h boundary; constraint cost is reported separately and is not monetized
base_checkpoint_contract.disturbance_visibility: only currently observable plant effects; no future schedule, seed, or selected market regime

electricity_model.calibration: Inferred off-grid architecture; fixed costs unknown, excluded from modeled operating contribution, not asserted zero.

policy_identity.base_observation: actual returned float32[135]; no extra encoding
policy_identity.normalization: cached target / installed rating, clipped to [0,1]
policy_identity.mapping: E at/below stable floor is preserved; otherwise floor+(E-floor)*(1+0.1*r). Other targets multiply by (1+0.1*r); current authority caps apply. Zero residual returns the exact original command.

prior.information_set: Current public plant, delivery and cycle observation; static plant and commitment profile; no future truth or scenario identity.
prior.objective: Deliver current daily obligations and restore opening stocks before nightfall; economic prices unused.

policy_identity.authority: Bounded residual only; no feasibility or safety guarantee and no policy substitution.

electricity_model.calibration: Inferred off-grid architecture; fixed costs unknown, excluded from modeled operating contribution, not asserted zero.
Inferred off-grid architecture; fixed costs unknown, excluded from modeled operating contribution, not asserted zero.

runs.change: New25kg/h off-grid task; original physical draw and all mandatory service, daily inventory and safety requirements retained.

base_layout.cycle_information: 24 h progress plus signed battery/H2/CO2/CH4 margins to one non-ratcheting opening reference
base_layout.constraint_output: per-cycle resource return feasibility and cost vector

interface_contract.market_fields: Effective accepted-solar dispatch charge; zero for dedicated PV without export. Underlying synthetic market remains private audit data.

timing.time_semantics: observe boundary t; hold one decision over [t,t+decision_interval); settle a deadline after production in its final physical interval; expose only the causal forecast issued at t with half-open lead windows
timing.flow_sampling_semantics: timestamp and inventories are current after the preceding decision interval; solar availability/potential/output factor and equipment health/online state are the final one-minute dispatch sample in that interval; power, load, and production are time-weighted means over the whole interval (reset uses the initial boundary sample because no interval exists); electrolyser commitment mode, timers, prior accepted power, and ramp headroom are current boundary state
timing.guard_semantics: controllers decide from causal boundary telemetry; before every physical step the actuator guard applies absolute kW caps against the simulator-owned solar bus that same step will dispatch
timing.episode_end_semantics: the configured contract horizon is an intrinsic finite-horizon termination (terminated=true, truncated=false); terminal inventory is valued once and value functions must not bootstrap beyond the final observation

common_setpoint_authority.support_semantics: dispatcher-owned contemporaneous electrolyser-target shortfall, bounded by reserve-aware safety availability

assumptions.calibration_status: literature-anchored benchmark assumptions; not a vendor quote, site tariff, or bankable financial model

tariff.negative_price_semantics: renewable energy may be curtailed, so its opportunity price is floored at zero in the objective

economic_objective.realized_price_source: Effective electricity model price; dedicated PV has no export or purchase charge
economic_objective.negative_price_semantics: accepted renewable opportunity cost remains floored at zero

base_checkpoint_contract.cycle_constraint_semantics: battery, H2, CO2, and CH4 settle separately against one non-ratcheting episode-opening reference at each 24 h boundary; constraint cost is reported separately and is not monetized
base_checkpoint_contract.disturbance_visibility: only currently observable plant effects; no future schedule, seed, or selected market regime

electricity_model.calibration: Inferred off-grid architecture; fixed costs unknown, excluded from modeled operating contribution, not asserted zero.

policy_identity.base_observation: actual returned float32[135]; no extra encoding
policy_identity.normalization: cached target / installed rating, clipped to [0,1]
policy_identity.mapping: E at/below stable floor is preserved; otherwise floor+(E-floor)*(1+0.1*r). Other targets multiply by (1+0.1*r); current authority caps apply. Zero residual returns the exact original command.

prior.information_set: Current public plant, delivery and cycle observation; static plant and commitment profile; no future truth or scenario identity.
prior.objective: Deliver current daily obligations and restore opening stocks before nightfall; economic prices unused.

policy_identity.authority: Bounded residual only; no feasibility or safety guarantee and no policy substitution.

electricity_model.calibration: Inferred off-grid architecture; fixed costs unknown, excluded from modeled operating contribution, not asserted zero.
Inferred off-grid architecture; fixed costs unknown, excluded from modeled operating contribution, not asserted zero.

runs.change: New25kg/h off-grid task; original physical draw and all mandatory service, daily inventory and safety requirements retained.

base_layout.cycle_information: 24 h progress plus signed battery/H2/CO2/CH4 margins to one non-ratcheting opening reference
base_layout.constraint_output: per-cycle resource return feasibility and cost vector

interface_contract.market_fields: Effective accepted-solar dispatch charge; zero for dedicated PV without export. Underlying synthetic market remains private audit data.

timing.time_semantics: observe boundary t; hold one decision over [t,t+decision_interval); settle a deadline after production in its final physical interval; expose only the causal forecast issued at t with half-open lead windows
timing.flow_sampling_semantics: timestamp and inventories are current after the preceding decision interval; solar availability/potential/output factor and equipment health/online state are the final one-minute dispatch sample in that interval; power, load, and production are time-weighted means over the whole interval (reset uses the initial boundary sample because no interval exists); electrolyser commitment mode, timers, prior accepted power, and ramp headroom are current boundary state
timing.guard_semantics: controllers decide from causal boundary telemetry; before every physical step the actuator guard applies absolute kW caps against the simulator-owned solar bus that same step will dispatch
timing.episode_end_semantics: the configured contract horizon is an intrinsic finite-horizon termination (terminated=true, truncated=false); terminal inventory is valued once and value functions must not bootstrap beyond the final observation

common_setpoint_authority.support_semantics: dispatcher-owned contemporaneous electrolyser-target shortfall, bounded by reserve-aware safety availability

assumptions.calibration_status: literature-anchored benchmark assumptions; not a vendor quote, site tariff, or bankable financial model

tariff.negative_price_semantics: renewable energy may be curtailed, so its opportunity price is floored at zero in the objective

economic_objective.realized_price_source: Effective electricity model price; dedicated PV has no export or purchase charge
economic_objective.negative_price_semantics: accepted renewable opportunity cost remains floored at zero

base_checkpoint_contract.cycle_constraint_semantics: battery, H2, CO2, and CH4 settle separately against one non-ratcheting episode-opening reference at each 24 h boundary; constraint cost is reported separately and is not monetized
base_checkpoint_contract.disturbance_visibility: only currently observable plant effects; no future schedule, seed, or selected market regime

electricity_model.calibration: Inferred off-grid architecture; fixed costs unknown, excluded from modeled operating contribution, not asserted zero.

policy_identity.base_observation: actual returned float32[135]; no extra encoding
policy_identity.normalization: cached target / installed rating, clipped to [0,1]
policy_identity.mapping: E at/below stable floor is preserved; otherwise floor+(E-floor)*(1+0.1*r). Other targets multiply by (1+0.1*r); current authority caps apply. Zero residual returns the exact original command.

prior.information_set: Current public plant, delivery and cycle observation; static plant and commitment profile; no future truth or scenario identity.
prior.objective: Deliver current daily obligations and restore opening stocks before nightfall; economic prices unused.

policy_identity.authority: Bounded residual only; no feasibility or safety guarantee and no policy substitution.

electricity_model.calibration: Inferred off-grid architecture; fixed costs unknown, excluded from modeled operating contribution, not asserted zero.
Inferred off-grid architecture; fixed costs unknown, excluded from modeled operating contribution, not asserted zero.

runs.change: New25kg/h off-grid task; original physical draw and all mandatory service, daily inventory and safety requirements retained.

base_layout.cycle_information: 24 h progress plus signed battery/H2/CO2/CH4 margins to one non-ratcheting opening reference
base_layout.constraint_output: per-cycle resource return feasibility and cost vector

interface_contract.market_fields: Effective accepted-solar dispatch charge; zero for dedicated PV without export. Underlying synthetic market remains private audit data.

timing.time_semantics: observe boundary t; hold one decision over [t,t+decision_interval); settle a deadline after production in its final physical interval; expose only the causal forecast issued at t with half-open lead windows
timing.flow_sampling_semantics: timestamp and inventories are current after the preceding decision interval; solar availability/potential/output factor and equipment health/online state are the final one-minute dispatch sample in that interval; power, load, and production are time-weighted means over the whole interval (reset uses the initial boundary sample because no interval exists); electrolyser commitment mode, timers, prior accepted power, and ramp headroom are current boundary state
timing.guard_semantics: controllers decide from causal boundary telemetry; before every physical step the actuator guard applies absolute kW caps against the simulator-owned solar bus that same step will dispatch
timing.episode_end_semantics: the configured contract horizon is an intrinsic finite-horizon termination (terminated=true, truncated=false); terminal inventory is valued once and value functions must not bootstrap beyond the final observation

common_setpoint_authority.support_semantics: dispatcher-owned contemporaneous electrolyser-target shortfall, bounded by reserve-aware safety availability

assumptions.calibration_status: literature-anchored benchmark assumptions; not a vendor quote, site tariff, or bankable financial model

tariff.negative_price_semantics: renewable energy may be curtailed, so its opportunity price is floored at zero in the objective

economic_objective.realized_price_source: Effective electricity model price; dedicated PV has no export or purchase charge
economic_objective.negative_price_semantics: accepted renewable opportunity cost remains floored at zero

base_checkpoint_contract.cycle_constraint_semantics: battery, H2, CO2, and CH4 settle separately against one non-ratcheting episode-opening reference at each 24 h boundary; constraint cost is reported separately and is not monetized
base_checkpoint_contract.disturbance_visibility: only currently observable plant effects; no future schedule, seed, or selected market regime

electricity_model.calibration: Inferred off-grid architecture; fixed costs unknown, excluded from modeled operating contribution, not asserted zero.

policy_identity.base_observation: actual returned float32[135]; no extra encoding
policy_identity.normalization: cached target / installed rating, clipped to [0,1]
policy_identity.mapping: E at/below stable floor is preserved; otherwise floor+(E-floor)*(1+0.1*r). Other targets multiply by (1+0.1*r); current authority caps apply. Zero residual returns the exact original command.

prior.information_set: Current public plant, delivery and cycle observation; static plant and commitment profile; no future truth or scenario identity.
prior.objective: Deliver current daily obligations and restore opening stocks before nightfall; economic prices unused.

policy_identity.authority: Bounded residual only; no feasibility or safety guarantee and no policy substitution.

electricity_model.calibration: Inferred off-grid architecture; fixed costs unknown, excluded from modeled operating contribution, not asserted zero.
Inferred off-grid architecture; fixed costs unknown, excluded from modeled operating contribution, not asserted zero.

runs.change: New25kg/h off-grid task; original physical draw and all mandatory service, daily inventory and safety requirements retained.

base_layout.cycle_information: 24 h progress plus signed battery/H2/CO2/CH4 margins to one non-ratcheting opening reference
base_layout.constraint_output: per-cycle resource return feasibility and cost vector

interface_contract.market_fields: Effective accepted-solar dispatch charge; zero for dedicated PV without export. Underlying synthetic market remains private audit data.

timing.time_semantics: observe boundary t; hold one decision over [t,t+decision_interval); settle a deadline after production in its final physical interval; expose only the causal forecast issued at t with half-open lead windows
timing.flow_sampling_semantics: timestamp and inventories are current after the preceding decision interval; solar availability/potential/output factor and equipment health/online state are the final one-minute dispatch sample in that interval; power, load, and production are time-weighted means over the whole interval (reset uses the initial boundary sample because no interval exists); electrolyser commitment mode, timers, prior accepted power, and ramp headroom are current boundary state
timing.guard_semantics: controllers decide from causal boundary telemetry; before every physical step the actuator guard applies absolute kW caps against the simulator-owned solar bus that same step will dispatch
timing.episode_end_semantics: the configured contract horizon is an intrinsic finite-horizon termination (terminated=true, truncated=false); terminal inventory is valued once and value functions must not bootstrap beyond the final observation

common_setpoint_authority.support_semantics: dispatcher-owned contemporaneous electrolyser-target shortfall, bounded by reserve-aware safety availability

assumptions.calibration_status: literature-anchored benchmark assumptions; not a vendor quote, site tariff, or bankable financial model

tariff.negative_price_semantics: renewable energy may be curtailed, so its opportunity price is floored at zero in the objective

economic_objective.realized_price_source: Effective electricity model price; dedicated PV has no export or purchase charge
economic_objective.negative_price_semantics: accepted renewable opportunity cost remains floored at zero

base_checkpoint_contract.cycle_constraint_semantics: battery, H2, CO2, and CH4 settle separately against one non-ratcheting episode-opening reference at each 24 h boundary; constraint cost is reported separately and is not monetized
base_checkpoint_contract.disturbance_visibility: only currently observable plant effects; no future schedule, seed, or selected market regime

electricity_model.calibration: Inferred off-grid architecture; fixed costs unknown, excluded from modeled operating contribution, not asserted zero.

policy_identity.base_observation: actual returned float32[135]; no extra encoding
policy_identity.normalization: cached target / installed rating, clipped to [0,1]
policy_identity.mapping: E at/below stable floor is preserved; otherwise floor+(E-floor)*(1+0.1*r). Other targets multiply by (1+0.1*r); current authority caps apply. Zero residual returns the exact original command.

prior.information_set: Current public plant, delivery and cycle observation; static plant and commitment profile; no future truth or scenario identity.
prior.objective: Deliver current daily obligations and restore opening stocks before nightfall; economic prices unused.

policy_identity.authority: Bounded residual only; no feasibility or safety guarantee and no policy substitution.

electricity_model.calibration: Inferred off-grid architecture; fixed costs unknown, excluded from modeled operating contribution, not asserted zero.

base_layout.cycle_information: 24 h progress plus signed battery/H2/CO2/CH4 margins to one non-ratcheting opening reference
base_layout.constraint_output: per-cycle resource return feasibility and cost vector

interface_contract.market_fields: Effective accepted-solar dispatch charge; zero for dedicated PV without export. Underlying synthetic market remains private audit data.

timing.time_semantics: observe boundary t; hold one decision over [t,t+decision_interval); settle a deadline after production in its final physical interval; expose only the causal forecast issued at t with half-open lead windows
timing.flow_sampling_semantics: timestamp and inventories are current after the preceding decision interval; solar availability/potential/output factor and equipment health/online state are the final one-minute dispatch sample in that interval; power, load, and production are time-weighted means over the whole interval (reset uses the initial boundary sample because no interval exists); electrolyser commitment mode, timers, prior accepted power, and ramp headroom are current boundary state
timing.guard_semantics: controllers decide from causal boundary telemetry; before every physical step the actuator guard applies absolute kW caps against the simulator-owned solar bus that same step will dispatch
timing.episode_end_semantics: the configured contract horizon is an intrinsic finite-horizon termination (terminated=true, truncated=false); terminal inventory is valued once and value functions must not bootstrap beyond the final observation

common_setpoint_authority.support_semantics: dispatcher-owned contemporaneous electrolyser-target shortfall, bounded by reserve-aware safety availability

assumptions.calibration_status: literature-anchored benchmark assumptions; not a vendor quote, site tariff, or bankable financial model

tariff.negative_price_semantics: renewable energy may be curtailed, so its opportunity price is floored at zero in the objective

economic_objective.realized_price_source: Effective electricity model price; dedicated PV has no export or purchase charge
economic_objective.negative_price_semantics: accepted renewable opportunity cost remains floored at zero

base_checkpoint_contract.cycle_constraint_semantics: battery, H2, CO2, and CH4 settle separately against one non-ratcheting episode-opening reference at each 24 h boundary; constraint cost is reported separately and is not monetized
base_checkpoint_contract.disturbance_visibility: only currently observable plant effects; no future schedule, seed, or selected market regime

electricity_model.calibration: Inferred off-grid architecture; fixed costs unknown, excluded from modeled operating contribution, not asserted zero.

policy_identity.base_observation: actual returned float32[135]; no extra encoding
policy_identity.normalization: cached target / installed rating, clipped to [0,1]
policy_identity.mapping: E at/below stable floor is preserved; otherwise floor+(E-floor)*(1+0.1*r). Other targets multiply by (1+0.1*r); current authority caps apply. Zero residual returns the exact original command.

prior.information_set: Current public plant, delivery and cycle observation; static plant and commitment profile; no future truth or scenario identity.
prior.objective: Deliver current daily obligations and restore opening stocks before nightfall; economic prices unused.

policy_identity.authority: Bounded residual only; no feasibility or safety guarantee and no policy substitution.

timing.flow_sampling_semantics: timestamp and inventories are current after the preceding decision interval; solar availability/potential/output factor and equipment health/online state are the final one-minute dispatch sample in that interval; power, load, and production are time-weighted means over the whole interval (reset uses the initial boundary sample because no interval exists); electrolyser commitment mode, timers, prior accepted power, and ramp headroom are current boundary state
timing.guard_semantics: controllers decide from causal boundary telemetry; before every physical step the actuator guard applies absolute kW caps against the simulator-owned solar bus that same step will dispatch
timing.episode_end_semantics: the configured contract horizon is an intrinsic finite-horizon termination (terminated=true, truncated=false); terminal inventory is valued once and value functions must not bootstrap beyond the final observation

common_setpoint_authority.support_semantics: dispatcher-owned contemporaneous electrolyser-target shortfall, bounded by reserve-aware safety availability

assumptions.calibration_status: literature-anchored benchmark assumptions; not a vendor quote, site tariff, or bankable financial model

tariff.negative_price_semantics: renewable energy may be curtailed, so its opportunity price is floored at zero in the objective

economic_objective.realized_price_source: Effective electricity model price; dedicated PV has no export or purchase charge
economic_objective.negative_price_semantics: accepted renewable opportunity cost remains floored at zero

base_checkpoint_contract.cycle_constraint_semantics: battery, H2, CO2, and CH4 settle separately against one non-ratcheting episode-opening reference at each 24 h boundary; constraint cost is reported separately and is not monetized
base_checkpoint_contract.disturbance_visibility: only currently observable plant effects; no future schedule, seed, or selected market regime

electricity_model.calibration: Inferred off-grid architecture; fixed costs unknown, excluded from modeled operating contribution, not asserted zero.

policy_identity.base_observation: actual returned float32[135]; no extra encoding
policy_identity.normalization: cached target / installed rating, clipped to [0,1]
policy_identity.mapping: E at/below stable floor is preserved; otherwise floor+(E-floor)*(1+0.1*r). Other targets multiply by (1+0.1*r); current authority caps apply. Zero residual returns the exact original command.

prior.information_set: Current public plant, delivery and cycle observation; static plant and commitment profile; no future truth or scenario identity.
prior.objective: Deliver current daily obligations and restore opening stocks before nightfall; economic prices unused.

policy_identity.authority: Bounded residual only; no feasibility or safety guarantee and no policy substitution.

electricity_model.calibration: Inferred off-grid architecture; fixed costs unknown, excluded from modeled operating contribution, not asserted zero.

base_layout.cycle_information: 24 h progress plus signed battery/H2/CO2/CH4 margins to one non-ratcheting opening reference
base_layout.constraint_output: per-cycle resource return feasibility and cost vector

interface_contract.market_fields: Effective accepted-solar dispatch charge; zero for dedicated PV without export. Underlying synthetic market remains private audit data.

timing.time_semantics: observe boundary t; hold one decision over [t,t+decision_interval); settle a deadline after production in its final physical interval; expose only the causal forecast issued at t with half-open lead windows
timing.flow_sampling_semantics: timestamp and inventories are current after the preceding decision interval; solar availability/potential/output factor and equipment health/online state are the final one-minute dispatch sample in that interval; power, load, and production are time-weighted means over the whole interval (reset uses the initial boundary sample because no interval exists); electrolyser commitment mode, timers, prior accepted power, and ramp headroom are current boundary state
timing.guard_semantics: controllers decide from causal boundary telemetry; before every physical step the actuator guard applies absolute kW caps against the simulator-owned solar bus that same step will dispatch
timing.episode_end_semantics: the configured contract horizon is an intrinsic finite-horizon termination (terminated=true, truncated=false); terminal inventory is valued once and value functions must not bootstrap beyond the final observation

common_setpoint_authority.support_semantics: dispatcher-owned contemporaneous electrolyser-target shortfall, bounded by reserve-aware safety availability

assumptions.calibration_status: literature-anchored benchmark assumptions; not a vendor quote, site tariff, or bankable financial model

tariff.negative_price_semantics: renewable energy may be curtailed, so its opportunity price is floored at zero in the objective

economic_objective.realized_price_source: Effective electricity model price; dedicated PV has no export or purchase charge
economic_objective.negative_price_semantics: accepted renewable opportunity cost remains floored at zero

base_checkpoint_contract.cycle_constraint_semantics: battery, H2, CO2, and CH4 settle separately against one non-ratcheting episode-opening reference at each 24 h boundary; constraint cost is reported separately and is not monetized
base_checkpoint_contract.disturbance_visibility: only currently observable plant effects; no future schedule, seed, or selected market regime

electricity_model.calibration: Inferred off-grid architecture; fixed costs unknown, excluded from modeled operating contribution, not asserted zero.

policy_identity.base_observation: actual returned float32[135]; no extra encoding
policy_identity.normalization: cached target / installed rating, clipped to [0,1]
policy_identity.mapping: E at/below stable floor is preserved; otherwise floor+(E-floor)*(1+0.1*r). Other targets multiply by (1+0.1*r); current authority caps apply. Zero residual returns the exact original command.

prior.information_set: Current public plant, delivery and cycle observation; static plant and commitment profile; no future truth or scenario identity.
prior.objective: Deliver current daily obligations and restore opening stocks before nightfall; economic prices unused.

policy_identity.authority: Bounded residual only; no feasibility or safety guarantee and no policy substitution.

electricity_model.calibration: Inferred off-grid architecture; fixed costs unknown, excluded from modeled operating contribution, not asserted zero.

runs.change: New25kg/h off-grid task; original physical draw and all mandatory service, daily inventory and safety requirements retained.

base_layout.cycle_information: 24 h progress plus signed battery/H2/CO2/CH4 margins to one non-ratcheting opening reference
base_layout.constraint_output: per-cycle resource return feasibility and cost vector

interface_contract.market_fields: Effective accepted-solar dispatch charge; zero for dedicated PV without export. Underlying synthetic market remains private audit data.

timing.time_semantics: observe boundary t; hold one decision over [t,t+decision_interval); settle a deadline after production in its final physical interval; expose only the causal forecast issued at t with half-open lead windows
timing.flow_sampling_semantics: timestamp and inventories are current after the preceding decision interval; solar availability/potential/output factor and equipment health/online state are the final one-minute dispatch sample in that interval; power, load, and production are time-weighted means over the whole interval (reset uses the initial boundary sample because no interval exists); electrolyser commitment mode, timers, prior accepted power, and ramp headroom are current boundary state
timing.guard_semantics: controllers decide from causal boundary telemetry; before every physical step the actuator guard applies absolute kW caps against the simulator-owned solar bus that same step will dispatch
timing.episode_end_semantics: the configured contract horizon is an intrinsic finite-horizon termination (terminated=true, truncated=false); terminal inventory is valued once and value functions must not bootstrap beyond the final observation

common_setpoint_authority.support_semantics: dispatcher-owned contemporaneous electrolyser-target shortfall, bounded by reserve-aware safety availability

assumptions.calibration_status: literature-anchored benchmark assumptions; not a vendor quote, site tariff, or bankable financial model

tariff.negative_price_semantics: renewable energy may be curtailed, so its opportunity price is floored at zero in the objective

economic_objective.realized_price_source: Effective electricity model price; dedicated PV has no export or purchase charge
economic_objective.negative_price_semantics: accepted renewable opportunity cost remains floored at zero

base_checkpoint_contract.cycle_constraint_semantics: battery, H2, CO2, and CH4 settle separately against one non-ratcheting episode-opening reference at each 24 h boundary; constraint cost is reported separately and is not monetized
base_checkpoint_contract.disturbance_visibility: only currently observable plant effects; no future schedule, seed, or selected market regime

electricity_model.calibration: Inferred off-grid architecture; fixed costs unknown, excluded from modeled operating contribution, not asserted zero.

policy_identity.base_observation: actual returned float32[135]; no extra encoding
policy_identity.normalization: cached target / installed rating, clipped to [0,1]
policy_identity.mapping: E at/below stable floor is preserved; otherwise floor+(E-floor)*(1+0.1*r). Other targets multiply by (1+0.1*r); current authority caps apply. Zero residual returns the exact original command.

prior.information_set: Current public plant, delivery and cycle observation; static plant and commitment profile; no future truth or scenario identity.
prior.objective: Deliver current daily obligations and restore opening stocks before nightfall; economic prices unused.

policy_identity.authority: Bounded residual only; no feasibility or safety guarantee and no policy substitution.

electricity_model.calibration: Inferred off-grid architecture; fixed costs unknown, excluded from modeled operating contribution, not asserted zero.
Inferred off-grid architecture; fixed costs unknown, excluded from modeled operating contribution, not asserted zero.

runs.change: New25kg/h off-grid task; original physical draw and all mandatory service, daily inventory and safety requirements retained.

base_layout.cycle_information: 24 h progress plus signed battery/H2/CO2/CH4 margins to one non-ratcheting opening reference
base_layout.constraint_output: per-cycle resource return feasibility and cost vector

interface_contract.market_fields: Effective accepted-solar dispatch charge; zero for dedicated PV without export. Underlying synthetic market remains private audit data.

timing.time_semantics: observe boundary t; hold one decision over [t,t+decision_interval); settle a deadline after production in its final physical interval; expose only the causal forecast issued at t with half-open lead windows
timing.flow_sampling_semantics: timestamp and inventories are current after the preceding decision interval; solar availability/potential/output factor and equipment health/online state are the final one-minute dispatch sample in that interval; power, load, and production are time-weighted means over the whole interval (reset uses the initial boundary sample because no interval exists); electrolyser commitment mode, timers, prior accepted power, and ramp headroom are current boundary state
timing.guard_semantics: controllers decide from causal boundary telemetry; before every physical step the actuator guard applies absolute kW caps against the simulator-owned solar bus that same step will dispatch
timing.episode_end_semantics: the configured contract horizon is an intrinsic finite-horizon termination (terminated=true, truncated=false); terminal inventory is valued once and value functions must not bootstrap beyond the final observation

common_setpoint_authority.support_semantics: dispatcher-owned contemporaneous electrolyser-target shortfall, bounded by reserve-aware safety availability

assumptions.calibration_status: literature-anchored benchmark assumptions; not a vendor quote, site tariff, or bankable financial model

tariff.negative_price_semantics: renewable energy may be curtailed, so its opportunity price is floored at zero in the objective

economic_objective.realized_price_source: Effective electricity model price; dedicated PV has no export or purchase charge
economic_objective.negative_price_semantics: accepted renewable opportunity cost remains floored at zero

base_checkpoint_contract.cycle_constraint_semantics: battery, H2, CO2, and CH4 settle separately against one non-ratcheting episode-opening reference at each 24 h boundary; constraint cost is reported separately and is not monetized
base_checkpoint_contract.disturbance_visibility: only currently observable plant effects; no future schedule, seed, or selected market regime

electricity_model.calibration: Inferred off-grid architecture; fixed costs unknown, excluded from modeled operating contribution, not asserted zero.

policy_identity.base_observation: actual returned float32[135]; no extra encoding
policy_identity.normalization: cached target / installed rating, clipped to [0,1]
policy_identity.mapping: E at/below stable floor is preserved; otherwise floor+(E-floor)*(1+0.1*r). Other targets multiply by (1+0.1*r); current authority caps apply. Zero residual returns the exact original command.

prior.information_set: Current public plant, delivery and cycle observation; static plant and commitment profile; no future truth or scenario identity.
prior.objective: Deliver current daily obligations and restore opening stocks before nightfall; economic prices unused.

policy_identity.authority: Bounded residual only; no feasibility or safety guarantee and no policy substitution.

electricity_model.calibration: Inferred off-grid architecture; fixed costs unknown, excluded from modeled operating contribution, not asserted zero.
Inferred off-grid architecture; fixed costs unknown, excluded from modeled operating contribution, not asserted zero.

runs.change: New25kg/h off-grid task; original physical draw and all mandatory service, daily inventory and safety requirements retained.

base_layout.cycle_information: 24 h progress plus signed battery/H2/CO2/CH4 margins to one non-ratcheting opening reference
base_layout.constraint_output: per-cycle resource return feasibility and cost vector

interface_contract.market_fields: Effective accepted-solar dispatch charge; zero for dedicated PV without export. Underlying synthetic market remains private audit data.

timing.time_semantics: observe boundary t; hold one decision over [t,t+decision_interval); settle a deadline after production in its final physical interval; expose only the causal forecast issued at t with half-open lead windows
timing.flow_sampling_semantics: timestamp and inventories are current after the preceding decision interval; solar availability/potential/output factor and equipment health/online state are the final one-minute dispatch sample in that interval; power, load, and production are time-weighted means over the whole interval (reset uses the initial boundary sample because no interval exists); electrolyser commitment mode, timers, prior accepted power, and ramp headroom are current boundary state
timing.guard_semantics: controllers decide from causal boundary telemetry; before every physical step the actuator guard applies absolute kW caps against the simulator-owned solar bus that same step will dispatch
timing.episode_end_semantics: the configured contract horizon is an intrinsic finite-horizon termination (terminated=true, truncated=false); terminal inventory is valued once and value functions must not bootstrap beyond the final observation

common_setpoint_authority.support_semantics: dispatcher-owned contemporaneous electrolyser-target shortfall, bounded by reserve-aware safety availability

assumptions.calibration_status: literature-anchored benchmark assumptions; not a vendor quote, site tariff, or bankable financial model

tariff.negative_price_semantics: renewable energy may be curtailed, so its opportunity price is floored at zero in the objective

economic_objective.realized_price_source: Effective electricity model price; dedicated PV has no export or purchase charge
economic_objective.negative_price_semantics: accepted renewable opportunity cost remains floored at zero

base_checkpoint_contract.cycle_constraint_semantics: battery, H2, CO2, and CH4 settle separately against one non-ratcheting episode-opening reference at each 24 h boundary; constraint cost is reported separately and is not monetized
base_checkpoint_contract.disturbance_visibility: only currently observable plant effects; no future schedule, seed, or selected market regime

electricity_model.calibration: Inferred off-grid architecture; fixed costs unknown, excluded from modeled operating contribution, not asserted zero.

policy_identity.base_observation: actual returned float32[135]; no extra encoding
policy_identity.normalization: cached target / installed rating, clipped to [0,1]
policy_identity.mapping: E at/below stable floor is preserved; otherwise floor+(E-floor)*(1+0.1*r). Other targets multiply by (1+0.1*r); current authority caps apply. Zero residual returns the exact original command.

prior.information_set: Current public plant, delivery and cycle observation; static plant and commitment profile; no future truth or scenario identity.
prior.objective: Deliver current daily obligations and restore opening stocks before nightfall; economic prices unused.

policy_identity.authority: Bounded residual only; no feasibility or safety guarantee and no policy substitution.

electricity_model.calibration: Inferred off-grid architecture; fixed costs unknown, excluded from modeled operating contribution, not asserted zero.
Inferred off-grid architecture; fixed costs unknown, excluded from modeled operating contribution, not asserted zero.

runs.change: New25kg/h off-grid task; original physical draw and all mandatory service, daily inventory and safety requirements retained.

base_layout.cycle_information: 24 h progress plus signed battery/H2/CO2/CH4 margins to one non-ratcheting opening reference
base_layout.constraint_output: per-cycle resource return feasibility and cost vector

interface_contract.market_fields: Effective accepted-solar dispatch charge; zero for dedicated PV without export. Underlying synthetic market remains private audit data.

timing.time_semantics: observe boundary t; hold one decision over [t,t+decision_interval); settle a deadline after production in its final physical interval; expose only the causal forecast issued at t with half-open lead windows
timing.flow_sampling_semantics: timestamp and inventories are current after the preceding decision interval; solar availability/potential/output factor and equipment health/online state are the final one-minute dispatch sample in that interval; power, load, and production are time-weighted means over the whole interval (reset uses the initial boundary sample because no interval exists); electrolyser commitment mode, timers, prior accepted power, and ramp headroom are current boundary state
timing.guard_semantics: controllers decide from causal boundary telemetry; before every physical step the actuator guard applies absolute kW caps against the simulator-owned solar bus that same step will dispatch
timing.episode_end_semantics: the configured contract horizon is an intrinsic finite-horizon termination (terminated=true, truncated=false); terminal inventory is valued once and value functions must not bootstrap beyond the final observation

common_setpoint_authority.support_semantics: dispatcher-owned contemporaneous electrolyser-target shortfall, bounded by reserve-aware safety availability

assumptions.calibration_status: literature-anchored benchmark assumptions; not a vendor quote, site tariff, or bankable financial model

tariff.negative_price_semantics: renewable energy may be curtailed, so its opportunity price is floored at zero in the objective

economic_objective.realized_price_source: Effective electricity model price; dedicated PV has no export or purchase charge
economic_objective.negative_price_semantics: accepted renewable opportunity cost remains floored at zero

base_checkpoint_contract.cycle_constraint_semantics: battery, H2, CO2, and CH4 settle separately against one non-ratcheting episode-opening reference at each 24 h boundary; constraint cost is reported separately and is not monetized
base_checkpoint_contract.disturbance_visibility: only currently observable plant effects; no future schedule, seed, or selected market regime

electricity_model.calibration: Inferred off-grid architecture; fixed costs unknown, excluded from modeled operating contribution, not asserted zero.

policy_identity.base_observation: actual returned float32[135]; no extra encoding
policy_identity.normalization: cached target / installed rating, clipped to [0,1]
policy_identity.mapping: E at/below stable floor is preserved; otherwise floor+(E-floor)*(1+0.1*r). Other targets multiply by (1+0.1*r); current authority caps apply. Zero residual returns the exact original command.

prior.information_set: Current public plant, delivery and cycle observation; static plant and commitment profile; no future truth or scenario identity.
prior.objective: Deliver current daily obligations and restore opening stocks before nightfall; economic prices unused.

policy_identity.authority: Bounded residual only; no feasibility or safety guarantee and no policy substitution.

electricity_model.calibration: Inferred off-grid architecture; fixed costs unknown, excluded from modeled operating contribution, not asserted zero.
Inferred off-grid architecture; fixed costs unknown, excluded from modeled operating contribution, not asserted zero.

runs.change: New25kg/h off-grid task; original physical draw and all mandatory service, daily inventory and safety requirements retained.

base_layout.cycle_information: 24 h progress plus signed battery/H2/CO2/CH4 margins to one non-ratcheting opening reference
base_layout.constraint_output: per-cycle resource return feasibility and cost vector

interface_contract.market_fields: Effective accepted-solar dispatch charge; zero for dedicated PV without export. Underlying synthetic market remains private audit data.

timing.time_semantics: observe boundary t; hold one decision over [t,t+decision_interval); settle a deadline after production in its final physical interval; expose only the causal forecast issued at t with half-open lead windows
timing.flow_sampling_semantics: timestamp and inventories are current after the preceding decision interval; solar availability/potential/output factor and equipment health/online state are the final one-minute dispatch sample in that interval; power, load, and production are time-weighted means over the whole interval (reset uses the initial boundary sample because no interval exists); electrolyser commitment mode, timers, prior accepted power, and ramp headroom are current boundary state
timing.guard_semantics: controllers decide from causal boundary telemetry; before every physical step the actuator guard applies absolute kW caps against the simulator-owned solar bus that same step will dispatch
timing.episode_end_semantics: the configured contract horizon is an intrinsic finite-horizon termination (terminated=true, truncated=false); terminal inventory is valued once and value functions must not bootstrap beyond the final observation

common_setpoint_authority.support_semantics: dispatcher-owned contemporaneous electrolyser-target shortfall, bounded by reserve-aware safety availability

assumptions.calibration_status: literature-anchored benchmark assumptions; not a vendor quote, site tariff, or bankable financial model

tariff.negative_price_semantics: renewable energy may be curtailed, so its opportunity price is floored at zero in the objective

economic_objective.realized_price_source: Effective electricity model price; dedicated PV has no export or purchase charge
economic_objective.negative_price_semantics: accepted renewable opportunity cost remains floored at zero

base_checkpoint_contract.cycle_constraint_semantics: battery, H2, CO2, and CH4 settle separately against one non-ratcheting episode-opening reference at each 24 h boundary; constraint cost is reported separately and is not monetized
base_checkpoint_contract.disturbance_visibility: only currently observable plant effects; no future schedule, seed, or selected market regime

electricity_model.calibration: Inferred off-grid architecture; fixed costs unknown, excluded from modeled operating contribution, not asserted zero.

policy_identity.base_observation: actual returned float32[135]; no extra encoding
policy_identity.normalization: cached target / installed rating, clipped to [0,1]
policy_identity.mapping: E at/below stable floor is preserved; otherwise floor+(E-floor)*(1+0.1*r). Other targets multiply by (1+0.1*r); current authority caps apply. Zero residual returns the exact original command.

prior.information_set: Current public plant, delivery and cycle observation; static plant and commitment profile; no future truth or scenario identity.
prior.objective: Deliver current daily obligations and restore opening stocks before nightfall; economic prices unused.

policy_identity.authority: Bounded residual only; no feasibility or safety guarantee and no policy substitution.
